data.name: BATTLECREW™ Space Pirates
data.detailed_description:
JOIN THE CREW, RAID THE WORLDS


BATTLECREW™ Space Pirates é um shooter multijogador competitivo localizado num universo preenchido e em evolução.
O jogo está disponível no Acesso Antecipado do Steam!

Joga com os piratas mais cativantes e carismáticos da galáxia! Todas as personagens têm ataques, defesas e atributos de movimento únicos: só tens de descobrir a que se adapta melhor a ti!

Lidera a tua equipa em batalhas épicas e intensas! Enfrenta equipas inimigas com a mesma categoria e sede de sangue da tua! Rouba o máximo de ouro possível aos adversários, transforma-os em poeira espacial e torna-te o pirata mais temido e respeitado dos quatro cantos da galáxia!

Por entre as batalhas, atraca em Tortuga, uma estação especial que se tornou a base e local de encontro dos piores corsários da Via Láctea! Encontra novos membros para a tua equipa ou convida os teus amigos para jogarem, consulta as pontuações online e participa nos desafios da comunidade decorrentes…

BATTLECREW é mais do que um shoot 'em up; é um jogo vivo! Os jogadores podem desbloquear cenários, provocações e modos de jogo ao vencerem os desafios da comunidade que são atualizados regularmente!

Levanta voo e junta-te à aventura galáctica mais louca em anos-luz!

destaques

  • Jogabilidade rápida e viciante criada para a competição: no BATTLECREW, as partidas são baseadas na habilidade e na cooperação para até 8 jogadores!
  • Um elenco colorido de piratas cativantes e carismáticos! Encontras 4 classes de personagem, cada uma delas com um estilo de jogo diferente!
  • Tortuga, o centro da comunidade do jogo, é o local onde os piratas vivem e se encontram para verificar as estatísticas e tabelas de liderança do jogo, personalizarem os seus avatares, consultarem os desafios da comunidade e iniciar partidas.
  • Prémios para os piratas: o BATTLECREW desafia a comunidade regularmente! Mapas, skins, provocações, modos de jogo… Todo este conteúdo desbloqueável torna o BATTLECREW um universo preenchido e em evolução!
  • 2 modos de jogo no Acesso Antecipado: Gold Rush, onde cada equipa tem de recolher o máximo de ouro possível para ganhar, e o clássico Team Death Match onde tens de vaporizar todos os piratas inimigos que conseguires para alcançares a vitória!

reviews.review:
BATTLECREW Space Pirates is a multiplayer action platform shooter developed and published by DONTNOD ELEVEN that combines hero-based combat, side-scrolling gunplay, and fast arcade-style movement into a chaotic competitive experience. Built around team-focused multiplayer battles, the game attempts to merge the energy of modern hero shooters with the speed and mobility of classic 2D action games. While the concept itself is highly creative, the game ultimately became a niche multiplayer title remembered more for its strong gameplay ideas than for long-term commercial success.

Set within a colorful science-fiction universe filled with eccentric pirates and futuristic technology, the game focuses entirely on competitive arena combat rather than story-driven progression. Players battle across stylized environments inspired by comic books and arcade shooters, where movement and positioning matter just as much as raw aiming skill. The exaggerated presentation immediately gives the game a playful identity, and its lighthearted tone helps separate it from more serious military-themed online shooters.

The gameplay revolves around team-based matches where players choose unique characters equipped with specialized weapons and abilities. Every pirate fills a different combat role, encouraging players to experiment with aggressive offense, defensive support, area control, or high-speed mobility depending on personal preference. Some characters excel at close-range ambushes and fast movement, while others focus on heavy firepower or controlling portions of the battlefield with powerful abilities. This hero-based design creates tactical variety and encourages coordination between teammates during competitive matches.

Movement is easily one of the game’s strongest features. Characters can dash, leap, wall jump, teleport, and chain movement abilities together at high speed, creating matches that feel energetic from beginning to end. Instead of slowly exchanging fire from cover, players are constantly repositioning around the arena while attempting to outmaneuver opponents through mobility and quick reactions. Skilled players can use the game’s acrobatic movement system to escape danger, launch surprise attacks, or maintain control over strategic areas of the map. This emphasis on speed gives the combat a satisfying arcade feel that remains enjoyable even after repeated matches.

The level design complements this movement-heavy gameplay effectively. Arenas feature layered platforms, vertical combat spaces, tight corridors, and open firing zones that constantly encourage repositioning and aggressive play. Because battles can erupt from multiple angles simultaneously, players must remain aware of both their surroundings and enemy movement at all times. The side-scrolling perspective gives firefights a distinct style compared to traditional multiplayer shooters, making combat feel fresh despite borrowing familiar hero-shooter mechanics.

Visually, BATTLECREW Space Pirates succeeds because of its bold comic-inspired art direction. Characters are colorful and expressive, with exaggerated designs that make every pirate feel distinct and memorable. The futuristic environments are filled with vibrant lighting effects, explosions, and animated details that reinforce the game’s chaotic tone. Even during intense firefights, the visuals generally remain readable enough for players to follow enemy movement and attacks without becoming completely overwhelmed.

The audio design also supports the fast pacing effectively. Weapon sounds feel impactful, ability effects carry strong audio feedback, and the energetic soundtrack helps maintain momentum throughout matches. Character voice lines and combat effects add personality to the experience, reinforcing the game’s arcade-inspired atmosphere. The presentation overall feels polished and lively, especially during intense team battles where movement and explosions dominate the screen.

Despite these strengths, BATTLECREW Space Pirates struggled with several major issues that prevented it from reaching a larger audience. One of the biggest problems was the limited amount of content available. The game launched with a relatively small selection of maps, modes, and characters, causing repetition to appear quickly for players seeking long-term progression or variety. Since multiplayer-focused games rely heavily on player retention, this lack of content became increasingly noticeable over time.

Balancing problems also affected the competitive experience. Certain characters and mobility-focused strategies occasionally felt significantly stronger than others, especially in matches involving highly skilled players. Newcomers often found themselves overwhelmed by experienced opponents who had already mastered the movement system and map layouts. The steep skill gap made the game difficult to approach casually, particularly for players unfamiliar with fast-paced arena shooters.

The game’s free-to-play structure introduced additional frustrations. Some players criticized progression systems and play restrictions tied to monetization, arguing that these systems discouraged long-term engagement rather than supporting it. For a multiplayer title dependent on maintaining an active community, these issues contributed to declining player activity over time.

Even with these flaws, BATTLECREW Space Pirates remains a genuinely creative multiplayer shooter with a strong mechanical foundation. The combination of fast movement, side-scrolling combat, and hero-based abilities creates matches that feel exciting and unpredictable when the systems work together properly. The game never fully reached its potential, but the core gameplay still demonstrates how effective a 2D competitive hero shooter can be when supported by responsive controls and energetic pacing.

For players who enjoy arena shooters, platform-based combat, and competitive multiplayer games focused on movement and reflexes, BATTLECREW Space Pirates offers an entertaining experience filled with stylish action and chaotic firefights. Its limited content and balancing issues ultimately hold it back from becoming a major multiplayer success, but the game’s creativity and fast-paced combat still make it an interesting and underrated entry within the competitive shooter genre.

Rating: 7/10
